# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/leomosley/pigeon/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected version, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested
mitigation. You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days.

## Scope

Security reports are especially useful for credential exposure, overly broad
Cloudflare permissions, unsafe skill installation, command injection, and
unauthorized artifact access.

Only the latest released version receives security fixes.
